title: seq-triage samplesheet
description: One row per sample, or several rows with the same sample ID for a sample whose reads are in several files (lanes, top-up runs; D75). Hard rules only: anything unambiguously wrong in a single row, plus (in main.nf) rows of one sample that disagree. Cross-row soft checks run later in the R metadata screen.

sample.errorMessage: Sample ID must start with a letter or digit and contain only letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-' (it becomes part of output file names).

fastq_1.errorMessage: fastq_1 must be a FASTQ file (.fastq or .fq) or FASTA reads (.fa, .fasta, .fna; no quality values, so quality cannot be judged), plain or compressed as .gz, .bz2, .xz or .zst, with no spaces in the path. For BAM, SAM or CRAM use the bam column. Raw nanopore signal (POD5, FAST5) must be basecalled first (e.g. dorado); an Illumina run folder (BCL) must be demultiplexed first (bcl-convert); an SRA file (.sra) must be converted first (fasterq-dump).

fastq_2.errorMessage: fastq_2 must be a FASTQ file (.fastq or .fq) or FASTA reads (.fa, .fasta, .fna), plain, .gz, .bz2, .xz or .zst, with no spaces in the path. Leave it blank for single-end or long reads.

bam.errorMessage: bam must be a .bam, .sam or .cram file (aligned or unaligned) with no spaces in the path. CRAM needs its reference: --cram_fasta, or EBI's registry. Leave fastq_1 and fastq_2 blank when bam is given.

fastq_dir.errorMessage: fastq_dir must be an existing folder (no spaces in the path) holding the sample's FASTQ files (.fastq or .fq, plain or compressed), for example a nanopore barcode folder. Every file in it is one file of single-end or long reads. It must be a local or cluster path: a web address cannot be listed as a folder.

platform.errorMessage: platform must be illumina, ont, pacbio, dnbseq or element (nanopore, mgi, bgiseq and aviti are also accepted; case does not matter). Leave it blank to have the platform detected. PacBio is QC'd only as HiFi.

sample_type.errorMessage: sample_type must be isolate, metagenome, amplicon or unknown (case does not matter), or left blank.

molecule.errorMessage: molecule must be dna or rna (case does not matter), or left blank. Use rna for RNA-seq, metatranscriptomes and direct RNA, even when the reads are cDNA.

library.errorMessage: library must be bisulfite (also accepted: bisulphite, wgbs, rrbs, pbat, em-seq, methylation), or left blank. Declare it for a methylation library: the reads alone show it only when conversion is visible in them (D93).

target_taxid.errorMessage: target_taxid must be the NCBI taxonomy ID (a whole number) of the organism the sample is meant to be, e.g. 9606 for human, 4932 for Saccharomyces cerevisiae, 562 for Escherichia coli; or left blank.

genome_size.errorMessage: genome_size must be the expected genome size in bases, as a number (5200000) or with k, m or g (5.2m, 3g), or left blank. Used only for the depth-of-coverage estimate.

group.errorMessage: group must start with a letter or digit and contain only letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'. Give the same group to samples of one isolate or biological sample sequenced separately (short and long reads of one isolate; RNA and DNA of one metagenome).

items.errorMessage: Give exactly one of: fastq_1 (and fastq_2 for paired reads), bam, or fastq_dir.
